claims: The 2026 Oscars are the 98th Academy Awards.
A tie occurred at the 2026 Oscars in the Best Live Action Short Film category.
"The Singers" won the Best Live Action Short Film at the 2026 Oscars.
"Two People Exchanging Saliva" won the Best Live Action Short Film at the 2026 Oscars.
Kumail Nanjiani presented the Best Live Action Short Film category at the 2026 Oscars.
The tie at the 2026 Oscars marked the seventh tie in Oscar history.
The tie at the 2026 Oscars was the first tie since 2013.
